from pathlib import Path

png=bytearray(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n')
import struct,zlib

def chunk(t,d):
    png.extend(struct.pack('>I',len(d)))
    png.extend(t)
    png.extend(d)
    crc=zlib.crc32(t)
    crc=zlib.crc32(d,crc)&0xffffffff
    png.extend(struct.pack('>I',crc))

raw=b'\x00\xff\x00\x00\xff'
comp=zlib.compress(raw)
chunk(b'IDAT', comp)
chunk(b'IEND', b'')
p.write_bytes(png)
